fields.label: Names
fields.help: Your names as a couple, e.g. Elif & Can.

fields.label: Cover text
fields.sample:
We've reached the
best chapter of a
long story. Now it's
time to turn the page...
And this time, the
two of us are the stars.

fields.label: Story opening (after the drop cap)
fields.help: The large drop cap (L) is edited separately on the page; this field is its continuation.
fields.sample:
ooking back, it all
began at a moment
we never expected.

fields.label: Your story
fields.sample:
In the same city, under the same
sky, our paths crossed,
and from that day on, life
turned into a far more beautiful
story.
Small moments carried big
meaning. And simply,
honestly, in the truest
way, we chose each other.
Now, together with our
loved ones, we're crowning
this story with a new chapter.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample:
Thank you endlessly
for being with us
on our special day,
for sharing your love
and for sharing
in our happiness.

fields.label: Cover photo
fields.help: A portrait-orientation, warm-toned photo of the couple works best.

elements.text:
Two hearts
One road
And a story
that will last
forever...

elements.name: Alt başlık
elements.text: A STORY PLANNED BY CHANCE, WRITTEN BY OUR HEARTS...

elements.name: Çizelge 1 not
elements.text: It all began with a glance...

elements.name: Çizelge 2 not
elements.text: A long talk, a beautiful beginning...

elements.name: Çizelge 4 not
elements.text:
In good times and bad,
always side by side...

elements.name: El yazısı not
elements.text:
With you, each
moment is lovelier...”

elements.name: Mesaj 1
elements.text:
Seeing two people
who complete each other
the way you do inspires
us all.
So lucky to have you...

elements.name: Mesaj 2
elements.text:
Always hand in hand,
heart to heart...
May your joy last forever.

elements.name: Mesaj 3
elements.text:
When you're together,
the world is a better
place. So lucky to have you!

elements.name: Mesaj 4
elements.text:
Beautiful people
write beautiful stories...
And your story
gives us all hope.

elements.name: El yazısı alt
elements.text: having you with us makes everything more meaningful.
